about_the_game:
The playable character "Kaigaku" will become available for use in battles in "Versus Mode."

Additionally, items such as Profile Photos and Quotes are included.

What's included:

• Playable character “Kaigaku”

• Profile Photo

• Quotes

• Decorations

• Slayer ID Frames (*available as a mastery reward for “Kaigaku")

• Title (*available as a mastery reward for “Kaigaku")

• In-battle system voice for “Kaigaku” (*available as a mastery reward for “Kaigaku")

※To use this content, the separately sold base game "Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2" is required. Additionally, the latest patch must be applied.

※This product is also included in bundled set packages. Please review the product details carefully to avoid duplicate purchases.

※Additional characters can only be used in battles in "Versus Mode."

※In-battle system voice settings can be adjusted within “Versus Mode” (e.g., “Fight!” or “That's enough!”).

※Content and specifications are subject to change without notice.

※Game illustrations are created by CyberConnect2 Co., Ltd. based on the 3D models in-game.

content_descriptors.notes: There are blood effects and decapitation as you fight demons.
